name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: B2B Digital Marketing | Paid Search & LinkedIn, Funnel Analytics, CRM Nurture & Reporting
summary: B2B digital marketer who's deep in paid media and fluent across the rest of the funnel. At Level Agency I ran account-based LinkedIn campaigns with A/B-tested setups and planned budgets for accounts at $20K+/month in ad spend, peaking above $100K, reporting ROI, CAC, and LTV in QBRs. I've optimized Google Ads, built CRM nurture and lead scoring in HubSpot and GoHighLevel, instrumented GA4 and GTM tracking, and run SEO and CRO work. I turn the numbers into a clear story for leadership.

experience.title: Growth Marketing Lead — Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Optimized a client's Google Ads account to cut low-quality leads, then diagnosed on-site conversion as the remaining bottleneck.
Build CRM nurture, lifecycle stages, and lead scoring in HubSpot and GoHighLevel across email and SMS, holding deliverability above 99%.
Install GA4 conversion events, Meta Pixel, and Google Ads tags through custom GTM triggers, enforce UTM conventions, and build funnel and ROI dashboards in Power BI and SQL.
Run technical SEO audits and keyword gap analyses; published 18 articles, including 10 on semantic SEO and AI search visibility.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Ran account-based LinkedIn campaigns targeting small, highly researched audiences with A/B-tested setups.
Planned and allocated budgets across ~3 accounts at $20K+/month in ad spend each, peaking above $100K/month, coordinating execution across internal departments.
Built campaign reporting tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, and presented recommendations to client leadership in QBRs.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Built a channel of 15-20 reseller partners (deals ~$10K-$45K), retaining all but one (~94%).

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Analyzed paid media and creative performance at a performance marketing agency and closed 6 new-client deals averaging ~$22K.
